note: Everything the browser scripts keep on a person's device, in plain words. apps/web/test/storage-notice.test.ts fails when the scripts use a key that is not listed here, when a key listed here is no longer used, or when the Privacy page (apps/web/public/legal.html) does not carry the sentence of an item. Update this file and the page together. Run: bun apps/web/test/storage-scan.ts

items.say: On a player's phone: a random device id, so one ticket stays on one phone.
On a player's phone: the ticket, the prizes won and the last game opened, so the game works offline and comes back after a reload.
On a player's phone: the organizer's name and logo, so they show even without a connection.
On a player's phone: whether the sound is on.
An older version saved a player's number on the phone. The page now removes it.
In an organizer's browser tab, until the tab is closed: the sign-in, the e-mail and mobile number typed, and the page to open next.
In an organizer's browser: a sign-in token and a random device id for the console.
In an organizer's browser: the name, e-mail, mobile number and invoice details typed on the payment page, so the form is filled in next time.
In an organizer's browser: which setup steps are done and which messages were sent, for each game.
On the Refer & earn page: the partner's key, so the page opens again.
After a Refer & earn link: the partner's code, so a purchase is credited to the partner.
Whether the phone was already asked about notifications.

On the public pages only: a random visitor id and one first-party cookie, ctv, kept one year, to count visits. Never on game pages, never with names or numbers. With Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track no id is made.
On the public pages only, until the tab is closed: a visit number and what was already counted.
On any page: if something goes wrong while the phone is offline, a short error report waits here until the phone is online, is then sent and removed. It holds no names, numbers or typed text.

cookies.name: ctv
cookies.say: The only cookie: ctv, a random visitor id, first party, kept one year, on the public pages only.
